3. The FIR was lodged for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 498A and 406 read with Section 34 of the IPC.
The offence punishable under Section 406 of the IPC is compoundable under Section 320 of the CrPC.

An offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC can be quashed as per the judgments in Gian Singh versus State, 2012 (10) SCC 303, Narender versus State of Punjab,
2014 (16) SCC 466, Vikas Singh vs. State of H.P. (2023) I DMC 335 (HP) and Sanjay Kumar vs. State of H.P2023 (1) Him L.R. 602 based on the compromise, which are binding upon this Court.
